items.difficulty_reason: Elementary distinguished squares give an extension-by-zero short exact sequence and derived triangle: part (1) checks exactness on stalks at geometric points, writes the stalk sequence with the (u,v)-indexed direct sums, and proves exactness by the unique-preimage dichotomy (exactly one u over x, or none and exactly one v); part (2) transports the sequence to derived categories by computing restriction and extension-by-zero on any K-injective complex.
